CREATE TABLE admin_audit (
 id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, guild_id INTEGER NOT NULL, actor_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
 action TEXT NOT NULL, detail_json TEXT NOT NULL, created_at REAL NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE ambient_activity (
 channel_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, message_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
 last_response REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
)

CREATE TABLE avatar_assets (
 id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, guild_id INTEGER NOT NULL, character_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
 slot_key TEXT NOT NULL, image_hash TEXT NOT NULL, channel_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
 message_id INTEGER NOT NULL, url TEXT NOT NULL, created_at REAL NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE avatar_slots (
 character_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES characters(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 slot_key TEXT NOT NULL, label TEXT NOT NULL, description TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
 image BLOB, revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, image_hash TEXT,
 PRIMARY KEY(character_id,slot_key)
)

CREATE TABLE bot_settings (
 id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(id=1),
 soft_cap_usd REAL CHECK(soft_cap_usd IS NULL OR soft_cap_usd>=0),
 hard_cap_usd REAL CHECK(hard_cap_usd IS NULL OR hard_cap_usd>=0),
 reset_day INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(reset_day BETWEEN 1 AND 28),
 channel_notice INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(channel_notice IN (0,1)),
 revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
)

CREATE TABLE budget_notices (
 period TEXT NOT NULL, kind TEXT NOT NULL, target_id INTEGER NOT NULL, sent_at REAL NOT NULL,
 PRIMARY KEY(period,kind,target_id)
)

CREATE TABLE candidates (
 id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, guild_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
 scope_kind TEXT NOT NULL, scope_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
 content TEXT NOT NULL, evidence_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
 promoted INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
 UNIQUE(guild_id,scope_kind,scope_id,content)
)

CREATE TABLE channels (
 channel_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, guild_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
 space_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES spaces(id),
 default_cast TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', active_cast TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
 ambient INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, ambient_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
 last_ambient REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
)

CREATE TABLE character_balances (
 guild_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
 character_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES characters(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 balance INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(balance>=0), refill_day TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', updated_at REAL NOT NULL,
 PRIMARY KEY(guild_id,character_id)
)

CREATE TABLE characters (
 id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, guild_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
 world_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES spaces(id),
 name TEXT NOT NULL, card TEXT NOT NULL, avatar BLOB, archived INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, play_style TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', avatar_manual INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
 UNIQUE(guild_id,name)
)

CREATE TABLE consent (
 guild_id INTEGER NOT NULL, user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, enabled INTEGER NOT NULL,
 PRIMARY KEY(guild_id,user_id)
)

CREATE TABLE currency_balances (
 guild_id INTEGER NOT NULL, user_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
 balance INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(balance>=0), updated_at REAL NOT NULL,
 PRIMARY KEY(guild_id,user_id)
)

CREATE TABLE currency_daily (
 guild_id INTEGER NOT NULL, user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, last_day TEXT NOT NULL, streak INTEGER NOT NULL,
 PRIMARY KEY(guild_id,user_id)
)

CREATE TABLE currency_ledger (
 id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, guild_id INTEGER NOT NULL, user_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
 amount INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(amount<>0), balance_after INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(balance_after>=0),
 reason TEXT NOT NULL, actor_id INTEGER NOT NULL, source TEXT NOT NULL, reverses_id INTEGER, created_at REAL NOT NULL,
 holder_kind TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'member' CHECK(holder_kind IN ('member','character'))
)

CREATE TABLE encounters (
 id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, guild_id INTEGER NOT NULL, character_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
 space_id INTEGER NOT NULL, content TEXT NOT NULL, source_message_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
 UNIQUE(guild_id,character_id,space_id,content)
)

CREATE TABLE evidence (
 candidate_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES candidates(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 root_id INTEGER NOT NULL, source_message_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
 PRIMARY KEY(candidate_id,root_id)
)

CREATE TABLE game_cashouts (
 id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, guild_id INTEGER NOT NULL, table_id INTEGER NOT NULL, kind TEXT NOT NULL, ref_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
 bought_in INTEGER NOT NULL, cashed_out INTEGER NOT NULL, created_at REAL NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE game_channels (
 guild_id INTEGER NOT NULL, channel_id INTEGER NOT NULL, created_at REAL NOT NULL,
 PRIMARY KEY(guild_id,channel_id)
)

CREATE TABLE game_moves (
 id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, guild_id INTEGER NOT NULL, round_id INTEGER NOT NULL, seat_index INTEGER NOT NULL,
 move TEXT NOT NULL, actor TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(actor IN ('member','timeout','character')), created_at REAL NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE game_rounds (
 id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, guild_id INTEGER NOT NULL, table_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES game_tables(id),
 number INTEGER NOT NULL, seed TEXT NOT NULL, seed_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
 status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('joining','playing','settled','cancelled')),
 created_at REAL NOT NULL, dealt_at REAL, finished_at REAL, rules_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', button INTEGER,
 UNIQUE(table_id,number)
)

CREATE TABLE game_seats (
 guild_id INTEGER NOT NULL, round_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES game_rounds(id), seat_index INTEGER NOT NULL,
 kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(kind IN ('member','character')), ref_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
 stake INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(stake>=0), outcome TEXT, payout INTEGER, brought_by INTEGER, insurance INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
 stack INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(stack>=0),
 PRIMARY KEY(round_id,seat_index), UNIQUE(round_id,kind,ref_id)
)

CREATE TABLE game_settings (
 guild_id INTEGER NOT NULL, game TEXT NOT NULL, enabled INTEGER NOT NULL, rules_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', updated_at REAL NOT NULL,
 PRIMARY KEY(guild_id,game)
)

CREATE TABLE game_tables (
 id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, guild_id INTEGER NOT NULL, channel_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
 game TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('open','closed')),
 message_id INTEGER, opened_by INTEGER NOT NULL, created_at REAL NOT NULL, updated_at REAL NOT NULL,
 thread_id INTEGER, board_message_id INTEGER, turn_message_id INTEGER
)

CREATE TABLE guild_lore_entries (
 id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, guild_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
 scope_kind TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'guild' CHECK(scope_kind='guild'),
 scope_id INTEGER NOT NULL, content TEXT NOT NULL, keys_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
 constant INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, insertion_order INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 100,
 enabled INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, source_message_id INTEGER, promoted_from INTEGER,
 pinned INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, rule_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
 entry_key TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
)

CREATE TABLE guild_settings (
 guild_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, preset_id INTEGER, preset_revision INTEGER,
 asset_channel_id INTEGER, usage_footer INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
 timezone TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', turn_log_enabled INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, turn_log_days INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 14,
 catchup_anywhere INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, currency_name TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
 daily_amount INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, daily_streak_bonus INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, daily_streak_days INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 7,
 game_min_bet INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, game_max_bet INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1000,
 max_cast INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 5, max_favorites INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 5, archived_favorites INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
 character_refill_cap INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1000, game_character_talk INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, game_summary_rounds INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 5, blackjack_enabled INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
 game_talk_daily_limit INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 100, blackjack_rules TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', item_hold_cap INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 10,
 language TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''
)

CREATE TABLE hub_worlds (
 hub_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES spaces(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 world_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES spaces(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 PRIMARY KEY(hub_id,world_id)
)

CREATE TABLE import_entries (
 guild_id INTEGER NOT NULL, source_kind TEXT NOT NULL, source_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
 uid TEXT NOT NULL, entry_key TEXT NOT NULL, baseline_json TEXT NOT NULL,
 source_hash TEXT NOT NULL, disposition TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',
 PRIMARY KEY(guild_id,source_kind,source_id,uid)
)

CREATE TABLE inventory (
 guild_id INTEGER NOT NULL, user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, item_key TEXT NOT NULL,
 qty INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(qty>=0), last_used_at REAL,
 PRIMARY KEY(guild_id,user_id,item_key)
)

CREATE TABLE item_uses (
 id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, guild_id INTEGER NOT NULL, user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, channel_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
 item_key TEXT NOT NULL, seed TEXT NOT NULL, result TEXT NOT NULL, used_at REAL NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE lore (
 id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, guild_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
 scope_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(scope_kind IN ('character','space','channel','thread')),
 scope_id INTEGER NOT NULL, content TEXT NOT NULL, keys_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
 constant INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, insertion_order INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 100,
 enabled INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, source_message_id INTEGER,
 promoted_from INTEGER, pinned INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
, rule_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', entry_key TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0)

CREATE TABLE lore_activations (
 node_id INTEGER NOT NULL, entry_key TEXT NOT NULL,
 PRIMARY KEY(node_id,entry_key)
)

CREATE TABLE lorebook_entries (
 id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, book_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES lorebooks(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 uid TEXT NOT NULL, content TEXT NOT NULL, rule_json TEXT NOT NULL,
 source_hash TEXT NOT NULL, local_hash TEXT NOT NULL, entry_key TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, pinned INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, source_message_id INTEGER, promoted_from INTEGER,
 UNIQUE(book_id,uid)
)

CREATE TABLE lorebook_space_links (
 book_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES lorebooks(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 space_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES spaces(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 PRIMARY KEY(book_id,space_id)
)

CREATE TABLE lorebooks (
 id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, guild_id INTEGER NOT NULL, name TEXT NOT NULL,
 target_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(target_kind IN ('guild','channel')),
 target_id INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
 original_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
 UNIQUE(guild_id,name,target_kind,target_id)
)

CREATE TABLE member_favorites (
 guild_id INTEGER NOT NULL, user_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
 character_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES characters(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 position INTEGER NOT NULL, created_at REAL NOT NULL,
 PRIMARY KEY(guild_id,user_id,character_id)
)

CREATE TABLE member_settings (
 guild_id INTEGER NOT NULL, user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, favorites_mode TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'lean', updated_at REAL NOT NULL,
 spoken_moves INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(spoken_moves IN (0,1)),
 spoken_veto INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(spoken_veto IN (0,1)),
 PRIMARY KEY(guild_id,user_id)
)

CREATE TABLE model_roles (
 id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(id=1), dialogue TEXT, director TEXT, memory TEXT,
 revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
)

CREATE TABLE model_usage (
 id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, guild_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
 profile TEXT NOT NULL, model TEXT NOT NULL, role TEXT NOT NULL,
 input_tokens INTEGER, output_tokens INTEGER, cached_tokens INTEGER NOT NULL,
 reasoning_tokens INTEGER NOT NULL, cost_usd REAL, cost_basis TEXT NOT NULL,
 created_at REAL NOT NULL, channel_id INTEGER, feature TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''
)

CREATE TABLE nodes (
 message_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, guild_id INTEGER NOT NULL, channel_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
 parent_id INTEGER, root_id INTEGER NOT NULL, author_id INTEGER, character_id INTEGER,
 content TEXT NOT NULL, created_at REAL NOT NULL, context_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
 sources_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', author_label TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
 mentions_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'
)

CREATE TABLE owner_revisions (
 guild_id INTEGER NOT NULL, kind TEXT NOT NULL, owner_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
 revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY(guild_id,kind,owner_id)
)

CREATE TABLE personal_memories (
 id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, guild_id INTEGER NOT NULL, user_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
 character_id INTEGER NOT NULL, content TEXT NOT NULL,
 source_message_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
 UNIQUE(guild_id,user_id,character_id,content)
)

CREATE TABLE prompt_presets (
 id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, guild_id INTEGER NOT NULL, name TEXT NOT NULL,
 UNIQUE(guild_id,name)
)

CREATE TABLE prompt_revisions (
 preset_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES prompt_presets(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 revision INTEGER NOT NULL, bundle_json TEXT NOT NULL, created_at REAL NOT NULL,
 PRIMARY KEY(preset_id,revision)
)

CREATE TABLE scene_guidelines (
 guild_id INTEGER NOT NULL, kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(kind IN ('space','channel')),
 owner_id INTEGER NOT NULL, content TEXT NOT NULL, revision INTEGER NOT NULL,
 PRIMARY KEY(guild_id,kind,owner_id)
)

CREATE TABLE shop_items (
 guild_id INTEGER NOT NULL, item_key TEXT NOT NULL, for_sale INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, allow_use INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
 price INTEGER, cooldown_seconds INTEGER, extra_entries TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', replace_entries TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
 params TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
 PRIMARY KEY(guild_id,item_key)
)

CREATE TABLE spaces (
 id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, guild_id INTEGER NOT NULL, name TEXT NOT NULL,
 kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(kind IN ('world','hub')),
 hub_tone TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'in_character',
 UNIQUE(guild_id,name)
)

CREATE TABLE spend_days (
 day TEXT PRIMARY KEY, cost_usd REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
 unpriced_calls INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
)

CREATE TABLE spoken_examples (
 id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, guild_id INTEGER NOT NULL, game TEXT NOT NULL, text TEXT NOT NULL, label TEXT NOT NULL,
 created_by INTEGER, created_at REAL NOT NULL,
 UNIQUE(guild_id,game,text)
)

CREATE TABLE spoken_phrases (
 id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, guild_id INTEGER NOT NULL, user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, game TEXT NOT NULL, text TEXT NOT NULL,
 offered TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', band TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(band IN ('sure','unsure','silent')), scores TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
 kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(kind IN ('false_positive','false_negative')), label TEXT NOT NULL, created_at REAL NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE summaries (
 node_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES nodes(message_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 content TEXT NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE turn_log (
 id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, guild_id INTEGER NOT NULL, channel_id INTEGER, message_id INTEGER,
 stage TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', profile TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', model TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
 status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', reference_id TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', error_detail TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
 request_text TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', response_text TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
 input_tokens INTEGER, output_tokens INTEGER, created_at REAL NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE user_timezones (
 guild_id INTEGER NOT NULL, user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, timezone TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at REAL NOT NULL,
 PRIMARY KEY(guild_id,user_id)
)

CREATE TABLE vault_actions (
 id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, guild_id INTEGER NOT NULL, session_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES vault_sessions(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 stage_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES vault_stages(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, number INTEGER NOT NULL, user_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
 guess TEXT NOT NULL, feedback_json TEXT NOT NULL, won INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, action_key TEXT, created_at REAL NOT NULL,
 UNIQUE(session_id,number), UNIQUE(session_id,guess)
)

CREATE TABLE vault_advice (
 id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, guild_id INTEGER NOT NULL, session_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES vault_sessions(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, character_id INTEGER NOT NULL, guess TEXT NOT NULL, remaining INTEGER NOT NULL,
 source TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(source IN ('llm','template')), text TEXT, action_key TEXT, created_at REAL NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE vault_clues (
 id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, guild_id INTEGER NOT NULL, session_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES vault_sessions(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 position INTEGER NOT NULL, character_id INTEGER NOT NULL, kind TEXT NOT NULL, data_json TEXT NOT NULL, revealed_at REAL,
 UNIQUE(session_id,position)
)

CREATE TABLE vault_operation_actions (
 id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, guild_id INTEGER NOT NULL, operation_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES vault_operations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 stage_number INTEGER NOT NULL, attempt INTEGER NOT NULL, kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(kind IN ('guess','tool','cross','advice')), user_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
 number INTEGER, guess TEXT, feedback_json TEXT, won INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, tool_key TEXT, params_json TEXT, text_key TEXT, data_json TEXT,
 constraint_kind TEXT, constraint_json TEXT, turn_cost INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, use_id INTEGER, character_id INTEGER, remaining INTEGER,
 source TEXT, text TEXT, action_key TEXT, created_at REAL NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE vault_operation_claims (
 id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, guild_id INTEGER NOT NULL, operation_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES vault_operations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, type TEXT NOT NULL, amount INTEGER NOT NULL, ledger_id INTEGER NOT NULL, created_at REAL NOT NULL,
 UNIQUE(operation_id, user_id, type)
)

CREATE TABLE vault_operation_clues (
 id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, guild_id INTEGER NOT NULL, operation_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES vault_operations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 stage_number INTEGER NOT NULL, position INTEGER NOT NULL, character_id INTEGER NOT NULL, kind TEXT NOT NULL, data_json TEXT NOT NULL, revealed_at REAL,
 UNIQUE(operation_id,stage_number,position)
)

CREATE TABLE vault_operation_held (
 id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, guild_id INTEGER NOT NULL, operation_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES vault_operations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, type TEXT NOT NULL, amount INTEGER NOT NULL, created_at REAL NOT NULL,
 UNIQUE(operation_id, user_id, type)
)

CREATE TABLE vault_operation_participants (
 id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, guild_id INTEGER NOT NULL, operation_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES vault_operations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, advisor_id INTEGER, joined_at REAL NOT NULL,
 UNIQUE(operation_id,user_id)
)

CREATE TABLE vault_operation_settings (
 guild_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, enabled INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(enabled IN (0,1)), channel_id INTEGER,
 week_start INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(week_start BETWEEN 0 AND 6), stage_protocols_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
 contribution_reward INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(contribution_reward>=0), team_reward INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(team_reward>=0),
 min_guesses INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(min_guesses BETWEEN 1 AND 30), revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, updated_at REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
, support_reward INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(support_reward>=0))

CREATE TABLE vault_operation_stages (
 id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, guild_id INTEGER NOT NULL, operation_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES vault_operations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 number INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(number BETWEEN 1 AND 3), retry INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(retry IN (0,1)), protocol TEXT NOT NULL, length INTEGER NOT NULL,
 turn_budget INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(turn_budget>=1), secret TEXT NOT NULL, open_digit TEXT,
 status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active' CHECK(status IN ('active','solved','failed','expired')), created_at REAL NOT NULL, previous_secret TEXT,
 UNIQUE(operation_id,number)
)

CREATE TABLE vault_operations (
 id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, guild_id INTEGER NOT NULL, channel_id INTEGER NOT NULL, week_key TEXT NOT NULL,
 starts_at REAL NOT NULL, expires_at REAL NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active' CHECK(status IN ('active','solved','failed','expired')),
 npc_ids_json TEXT NOT NULL, protocols_json TEXT NOT NULL, created_by INTEGER NOT NULL, created_at REAL NOT NULL, finished_at REAL,
 UNIQUE(guild_id,channel_id,week_key)
)

CREATE TABLE vault_reward_claims (
 id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, guild_id INTEGER NOT NULL, session_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES vault_sessions(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, type TEXT NOT NULL, amount INTEGER NOT NULL, ledger_id INTEGER NOT NULL, created_at REAL NOT NULL,
 UNIQUE(session_id,user_id,type)
)

CREATE TABLE vault_sessions (
 id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, guild_id INTEGER NOT NULL, user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, channel_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
 kind TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'personal', local_date TEXT NOT NULL, protocol TEXT NOT NULL, length INTEGER NOT NULL,
 status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active' CHECK(status IN ('active','solved','failed','expired')),
 turn_budget INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(turn_budget>=1), secret TEXT NOT NULL, open_digit TEXT, partners_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
 created_at REAL NOT NULL, expires_at REAL NOT NULL, finished_at REAL,
 UNIQUE(guild_id,user_id,local_date)
)

CREATE TABLE vault_settings (
 guild_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, enabled INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(enabled IN (0,1)),
 protocols_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', turns_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', reward INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(reward>=0),
 revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, updated_at REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
 advice_cap INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 6 CHECK(advice_cap BETWEEN 0 AND 50), clue_voice TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'template' CHECK(clue_voice IN ('template','llm'))
)

CREATE TABLE vault_stages (
 id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, guild_id INTEGER NOT NULL, session_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES vault_sessions(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 number INTEGER NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active', turn_budget INTEGER NOT NULL, created_at REAL NOT NULL,
 UNIQUE(session_id,number)
)

CREATE TABLE vault_support_attempts (
 id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, guild_id INTEGER NOT NULL, mission_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES vault_support_missions(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 number INTEGER NOT NULL, answer_json TEXT NOT NULL, feedback_json TEXT, correct INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, action_key TEXT, created_at REAL NOT NULL,
 UNIQUE(mission_id, number), UNIQUE(mission_id, answer_json)
)

CREATE TABLE vault_support_missions (
 id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, guild_id INTEGER NOT NULL, operation_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES vault_operations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, mission_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(mission_type IN ('forensics','bulls_cows')), puzzle_json TEXT NOT NULL, answer_json TEXT NOT NULL,
 status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active' CHECK(status IN ('active','solved','failed')), attempts_used INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, created_at REAL NOT NULL, finished_at REAL,
 UNIQUE(operation_id, user_id)
)

CREATE TABLE vault_tool_uses (
 id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, guild_id INTEGER NOT NULL, session_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES vault_sessions(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 stage_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES vault_stages(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, tool_key TEXT NOT NULL,
 params_json TEXT NOT NULL, text_key TEXT NOT NULL, data_json TEXT NOT NULL, constraint_kind TEXT NOT NULL, constraint_json TEXT NOT NULL,
 turn_cost INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(turn_cost>=1), use_id INTEGER NOT NULL, action_key TEXT, created_at REAL NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE webhooks (
 channel_id INTEGER NOT NULL, character_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
 webhook_id INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(channel_id,character_id)
)
